value.rationale: The second distance and exact near-diametral pair count are natural refinements of Euclidean diameter. The theorem collapses an exponential/factorial pair optimization to O(n) explicit candidate comparisons, classifies three genuinely different structural mechanisms, and captures exact parameter-driven transitions and multiway ties (e.g. n=5,b=(38,38,25,25,64), gap=10000, 240 pairs). This is not the already known first diameter, a special-case substitution, or a small isolated numerical instance.
